summary: Runs an explicitly authorized configuration-bundle bootstrap when database schema startup remains in verify-only mode.
userImpact: Cloud deployments can apply approved platform identity providers without granting application replicas schema-migration or generic seed authority.
configuration: Configuration-bundle validate/apply mode remains independently controlled by EG_CONFIG_BOOTSTRAP_MODE; EG_DATABASE_STARTUP_MODE=verify still blocks migrations and generic seed writers.

notes: The fix changes startup orchestration only and adds no schema migration.

security: Configuration application retains its existing hash, tenant-scope, secret-preflight and fail-closed checks while schema and seed writers remain disabled in verify mode.
documentation: The generated technical release notes describe the independent database-startup and configuration-bootstrap authorities.
rollback: Redeploy the previous backend image; no database or configuration rollback is required.
validation: Startup-boundary tests cover successful and fail-closed configuration bootstrap in verify mode while proving migrations and generic seed writers remain disabled.
The configuration-bootstrap suite, backend-host build, focused lint and release-note preflight pass.
